svg.title: Sub-Engine — mark exploration
svg.desc: Six directions the Sub-Engine mark was resolved from, its construction, and its reduction.
svg.text: Solid mass, two seams, one gate.
Reads as a bar chart. The three
layers looked like data, not like
the thing the data runs on.
floats in open space instead of
as a list, which is what an
Pure data, honestly drawn. But a
Below 32px the 4u seam falls under a pixel and the Ø20 pip smears.
The cut redraws the seams at 12u, squares the gate and grows the pip to Ø30.
